body.en: A sinusoidal signal repeats smoothly over time. Amplitude measures its peak size, frequency counts cycles per second, and phase describes its position within a cycle relative to a reference. For x(t)=A sin(2*pi*f*t+phi), time is in seconds, f is in Hz and phi is in radians. The period is T=1/f. A 100 Hz signal therefore repeats every 0.01 s. Some software fields require angular frequency rather than Hz: enter omega=2*pi*f rad/s. Changing amplitude does not itself change frequency. Always read the axis units before comparing waveforms.
body.or: Sinusoidal signal ସମୟ ସହିତ ପୁଣିପୁଣି ସମାନ ଭାବରେ ବଦଳେ। Amplitude ଏହାର ସର୍ବାଧିକ ଆକାର, Frequency ଏକ ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ କେତେ cycle ହୁଏ, ଏବଂ Phase ଏକ reference ସହିତ cycle ର ସ୍ଥିତି ଦର୍ଶାଏ। Period T=1/f। 100 Hz signal ର Period 0.01 s। Simulink ର time-based Sine Wave block ରେ Frequency ପାଇଁ 2*pi*f rad/s ଦେବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ। Amplitude ବଦଳିଲେ Frequency ଆପେଆପେ ବଦଳେ ନାହିଁ। Waveform ତୁଳନା ପୂର୍ବରୁ axis ର unit ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।

title.en: Message, carrier and the purpose of modulation
title.or: Message, Carrier ଓ Modulation ର ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ

body.en: The message signal contains the information we want to convey. The carrier is a reference oscillation used to place that information into a suitable transmission frequency range. Modulation changes a property of the carrier according to the message. Amplitude modulation changes its amplitude, while angle modulation changes frequency or phase. Demodulation is the corresponding recovery process at the receiver. In our teaching model, the message is a 100 Hz sinusoid and the carrier is 2000 Hz. These are chosen laboratory values, not a claim about radio broadcast frequencies. A carrier alone does not contain the selected message.
body.or: Message signal ରେ ଆମେ ପଠାଇବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଥିବା ତଥ୍ୟ ଥାଏ। Carrier ଏକ reference oscillation, ଯାହା message କୁ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ transmission frequency ନିକଟକୁ ନେବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ। Modulation ରେ message ଅନୁସାରେ Carrier ର Amplitude, Frequency କିମ୍ବା Phase ବଦଳେ। Receiver ରେ ତଥ୍ୟ ଫେରାଇବା ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ହେଉଛି Demodulation। ଏହି lab ରେ message 100 Hz ଏବଂ carrier 2000 Hz ରଖିବା। ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଶିକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ବାଛିଥିବା ମୂଲ୍ୟ। କେବଳ Carrier ରେ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ message ଥାଏ ନାହିଁ।

title.en: Conventional AM, envelope and modulation index
title.or: Conventional AM, Envelope ଓ Modulation index

body.en: Conventional AM retains a carrier component and varies the surrounding envelope with the message. For a normalised single-tone message, s(t)=Ac[1+mu*cos(2*pi*fm*t)]cos(2*pi*fc*t), where mu is the modulation index. An envelope detector can follow the message when the envelope stays non-negative and its time constant is suitable. With 0<=mu<=1, the envelope does not cross zero; mu>1 causes overmodulation and distorts simple envelope recovery. If the envelope extrema are Emax and Emin, mu=(Emax-Emin)/(Emax+Emin). This envelope rule applies to conventional AM; it must not be applied blindly to DSB-SC.
body.or: Conventional AM ରେ Carrier component ରହେ ଏବଂ Envelope message ଅନୁସାରେ ବଦଳେ। Normalised single-tone message ପାଇଁ mu ହେଉଛି Modulation index। 0<=mu<=1 ହେଲେ Envelope ଶୂନ୍ୟକୁ ଅତିକ୍ରମ କରେ ନାହିଁ। mu>1 ହେଲେ Overmodulation ହୁଏ ଏବଂ ସରଳ Envelope detector ରେ message ବିକୃତ ହୋଇପାରେ। Envelope ର ସର୍ବାଧିକ ଓ ସର୍ବନିମ୍ନ ମୂଲ୍ୟରୁ mu=(Emax-Emin)/(Emax+Emin) ମିଳେ। ଏହି Envelope ନିୟମ Conventional AM ପାଇଁ; DSB-SC ରେ ସିଧାସଳଖ ଲାଗୁ କରିବା ଠିକ ନୁହେଁ।

body.en: DSB-SC is double-sideband suppressed-carrier amplitude modulation. Multiply a zero-mean message by a carrier to produce s(t)=Ac*m(t)*cos(2*pi*fc*t). For a sinusoidal message at fm, the product contains components at fc-fm and fc+fm: the lower and upper sidebands. Unlike conventional AM, no carrier offset is deliberately added. With a zero-mean message, there is no separate spectral carrier line at fc in the ideal model. A message DC offset can reintroduce that line. For fm=100 Hz and fc=2000 Hz, the sidebands are 1900 and 2100 Hz. Suppressed carrier does not mean that the transmitted signal is zero.
body.or: DSB-SC ର ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ନାମ Double-sideband suppressed-carrier amplitude modulation। Zero-mean Message କୁ Carrier ସହିତ ଗୁଣ କଲେ s(t)=Ac*m(t)*cos(2*pi*fc*t) ମିଳେ। Single-tone message ପାଇଁ Lower sideband fc-fm ଏବଂ Upper sideband fc+fm ରେ ହୁଏ। Conventional AM ପରି Carrier offset ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଏ ନାହିଁ। Ideal zero-mean model ରେ fc ରେ ଅଲଗା Carrier line ନଥାଏ। Message ର DC offset ଥିଲେ ସେହି line ଫେରିପାରେ। fm=100 Hz ଓ fc=2000 Hz ପାଇଁ Sidebands 1900 Hz ଓ 2100 Hz। Suppressed carrier ର ଅର୍ଥ output ଶୂନ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ।

body.en: Amplitude-modulation variants differ in which spectral components they transmit. DSB-SC sends both sidebands, requiring bandwidth 2B for a message whose highest frequency is B. SSB sends only one sideband and ideally requires bandwidth B, making better use of a restricted channel. VSB sends one sideband with a small vestige of the other; its bandwidth lies between ideal SSB and full DSB for a comparable message. The vestige eases practical filtering near the carrier. These are spectrum choices, not separate message types. Our lab uses DSB-SC, so SSB and VSB implementation is outside the lab route, although their comparison belongs in this chapter.

body.en: A coherent receiver multiplies the DSB-SC signal by a local oscillator matched to the transmitted carrier in frequency and phase. For unit-amplitude carriers, the product is m(t)*cos^2(2*pi*fc*t). Using cos^2(theta)=[1+cos(2*theta)]/2, this contains m(t)/2 plus a high-frequency term around twice the carrier. Lowpass filtering removes that high-frequency term while retaining the message band. A recovery gain of 2 restores the ideal message amplitude when both carrier amplitudes are one. A practical filter can still alter amplitude and phase slightly. Coherent recovery preserves message sign, whereas a simple envelope detector cannot recover a general signed DSB-SC message correctly.
body.or: Coherent receiver ର local oscillator କୁ transmitted Carrier ସହିତ Frequency ଓ Phase ରେ ମେଳାଇବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ। Unit-amplitude Carrier ପାଇଁ product m(t)*cos^2(2*pi*fc*t)। cos^2(theta)=[1+cos(2*theta)]/2 ରୁ m(t)/2 ଏବଂ ଉଚ୍ଚ Frequency ଅଂଶ ମିଳେ। Lowpass filter message band କୁ ରଖି ଉଚ୍ଚ Frequency ଅଂଶ କମାଏ। Carrier amplitude ଦୁଇଟି 1 ହେଲେ Gain 2 ideal message amplitude ଫେରାଏ। Practical filter କିଛି Amplitude ଓ Phase ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ କରିପାରେ। Coherent recovery message ର ଚିହ୍ନ ରଖେ; ସରଳ Envelope detector ସାଧାରଣ signed DSB-SC message ଠିକ ଭାବରେ ଫେରାଇପାରେ ନାହିଁ।

body.en: A lowpass filter is the separation stage after product detection. Its useful passband must include the message frequencies while its attenuation rejects the components near twice the carrier. Our bounded model uses a 100 Hz message, a 2000 Hz carrier and a second-order Butterworth lowpass with 500 Hz cutoff. In a continuous Transfer Fcn block, H(s)=wc^2/(s^2+sqrt(2)*wc*s+wc^2), where wc=2*pi*500 rad/s. This filter does not remove every unwanted component perfectly. It introduces a startup transient and frequency-dependent phase lag. Compare the recovered signal after startup, checking frequency and amplitude while allowing the predicted phase shift rather than demanding an identical trace.

body.en: Carrier mismatch is a receiver alignment problem, not automatically a failed transmitter. With equal carrier frequencies, a relative phase error phi scales the ideal recovered message by cos(phi) after gain correction. A 60 degree error leaves half amplitude; a 90 degree error suppresses the ideal message-band component. A finite filter can leave residual high-frequency ripple, so the observed trace need not be perfectly zero. A frequency mismatch adds a time-varying factor and can create a beating or distorted recovered waveform. Inspect the transmitter first, then compare the local oscillator frequency and phase with the carrier before changing unrelated blocks.
body.or: Carrier mismatch receiver ର alignment ସମସ୍ୟା ହୋଇପାରେ; ତେଣୁ transmitter ଖରାପ ବୋଲି ସିଧାସଳଖ ଧରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ। Frequency ସମାନ ହେଲେ relative Phase error phi ଦ୍ୱାରା ideal recovered message ର Amplitude cos(phi) ଗୁଣ ହୁଏ। 60 degree error ରେ ଅଧା Amplitude ରହେ। 90 degree error ରେ ideal message-band ଅଂଶ କମି ଶୂନ୍ୟ ହୁଏ; finite Filter ପାଇଁ କିଛି high-frequency Ripple ରହିପାରେ। Frequency mismatch ରେ recovery ସମୟ ସହିତ ବଦଳିପାରେ। ପ୍ରଥମେ transmitter ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ Local oscillator ର Frequency ଓ Phase ମେଳାନ୍ତୁ।

body.en: Frequency modulation, or FM, represents the message through changes in instantaneous carrier frequency rather than through carrier amplitude. An ideal FM signal has constant amplitude. Frequency deviation Delta f is the maximum departure from the carrier frequency. For a sinusoidal message of frequency fm, the modulation index is beta=Delta f/fm. FM generally has multiple sidebands, so its bandwidth is not simply the DSB-SC value 2B. Carson’s rule estimates a useful occupied bandwidth as approximately 2*(Delta f+B), where B is the highest message frequency. This is an engineering approximation, not an exact finite spectral boundary. FM is part of the chapter but not required to execute our selected DSB-SC lab.
body.or: Frequency modulation କିମ୍ବା FM ରେ Message ଅନୁସାରେ instantaneous Carrier frequency ବଦଳେ। Ideal FM ର Amplitude ସ୍ଥିର। Carrier frequency ଠାରୁ ସର୍ବାଧିକ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ହେଉଛି Frequency deviation Delta f। Single-tone message frequency fm ପାଇଁ Modulation index beta=Delta f/fm। FM ରେ ଅନେକ Sideband ଥାଇପାରେ। Carson’s rule ଅନୁସାରେ useful bandwidth ପ୍ରାୟ 2*(Delta f+B), ଯେଉଁଠି B ସର୍ବାଧିକ Message frequency। ଏହା ଏକ approximation, ସମସ୍ତ spectral component ର ନିଖୁତ ସୀମା ନୁହେଁ। FM chapter ରେ ଅଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ DSB-SC lab ପାଇଁ ପୂର୍ବଶର୍ତ୍ତ ନୁହେଁ।

body.en: Phase modulation, or PM, changes the instantaneous phase of a constant-amplitude carrier directly according to the message. Its form is s(t)=Ac*cos(2*pi*fc*t+kp*m(t)), where kp is phase sensitivity. FM and PM are both angle modulation, but their direct message relationships differ: FM frequency deviation follows the message, while PM phase deviation follows the message. Because instantaneous frequency is the rate of change of phase divided by 2*pi, PM frequency deviation follows the derivative of the message. A constant message produces a fixed phase shift in PM rather than a sustained frequency offset. PM completes our chapter comparison and is not a prerequisite for the selected lab.
body.or: Phase modulation କିମ୍ବା PM ରେ Message ଅନୁସାରେ constant-amplitude Carrier ର instantaneous Phase ସିଧାସଳଖ ବଦଳେ। s(t)=Ac*cos(2*pi*fc*t+kp*m(t)), ଯେଉଁଠି kp ହେଉଛି Phase sensitivity। FM ଓ PM ଦୁଇଟି Angle modulation। FM ର Frequency deviation Message ଅନୁସାରେ, PM ର Phase deviation Message ଅନୁସାରେ ବଦଳେ। Instantaneous Frequency ହେଉଛି Phase ର rate of change କୁ 2*pi ଦ୍ୱାରା ଭାଗ କଲେ ମିଳୁଥିବା ମୂଲ୍ୟ। ତେଣୁ PM ର Frequency deviation Message ର derivative ଅନୁସାରେ ବଦଳେ। Constant message PM ରେ fixed Phase shift ଦିଏ। PM ଏହି lab ର ପୂର୍ବଶର୍ତ୍ତ ନୁହେଁ।
